mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, a 0.5% decrease in UNRATE and a 1% increase in PAYEMS signal a tightening labor market, boosting productivity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window with jointly tightening labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: A 2% monthly increase in INDPRO signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of non-recessionary months with 2%+ INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, it signals increased retail sales, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 55% of instances with RSAFS > 6mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% monthly decrease in CPIAUCSL signals decreased inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns produce negative returns in > 50% of easing cycles with 1%+ CPIAUCSL decreases.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, a 1% increase in PAYEMS and a 0.2% decrease in UNRATE signal a strengthening labor market, but if FEDFUNDS is above 3%, this leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending monetary tightening.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window with jointly strengthening labor markets and FEDFUNDS > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% quarterly increase in HOUST signals a booming housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but this effect is muted if UNRATE is above 6%.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns produce negative returns in > 60% of instances with 5%+ HOUST growth and UNRATE < 6%.
